posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
If you want to be completely surprised by RC & IR, please do not read any further.

 

 

 

***********************************************************************************************************************************

 

 

 

 

With the reprint of RC&IR coming, i thought it would be appropriate to have an even around them. What I need is some challenges that use RC or IR. It doesn't matter what the challenge is. It could be just using a hero, beating someone, a full scenerio, it doesn't matter. The only requirement is that it has to have something from either RC or IR.

Just so we don't have one person giving 100 different challenges, each player can give up to 3: one easy, one medium, and one hard. Please list them in this thread, as well as here.

If you want to try the challenges, simply put your name on top of the spreadsheet, and indicate which challenges you have completed.

Becauase different people will be getting the game at different times, this event will go until January 2nd, so you have plenty of time to play everything.

Have fun everyone!

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I want to do more than 3!!!  Curse you Pydro and your sensible restrictions!!

Theme Challenges are the way to go.

Easy:

Man vs. Nature:  Defeat Akash'Bhutah in Pike Industrial Complex

Medium:

Sin City:  Defeat Apostate in Rook City.

Hard:

Parricide:  In Tomb of Anubis vs. the Ennead have Anubis defeat both Nephthys and Osiris.

 

Crossing over the expansions for the first two (with cool themes) and the last is just awesome, and the two best heroes to do it with are in the combined set.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Easy

Defeat Apostate while allowing him to flip at least once, and then again without him ever flipping (or vice versa).  You need not use the same Heroes or Environment.

Medium

Have Nightmist get at least 30 cards into her hand.

Difficult

On Advanced, have the team of Fixer, Nightmist and Argent Adept - no other heroes - defeat their nemeses in three consecutive battles in the same Environment.  All cards except those of the villains remain in play between matches and all HP totals are retained; any hero incapacitated in a battle begins the next battle alive at 1 HP with a new starting hand.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I added an Extreme category for ones I've done, but are harder than the normal hard ones.

Easy:

Unload!:  Fire all five of Expat's guns in one Unload.

Medium:

Praise God and Pass the Ammunition:  Use four or more Ammo cards in one turn.  

I'm No Villain (character card):  Have the Operative destroy the Chairman

Hard:

Full Assault:  Use all Six of Expat's Weapons (Guns+RPG Launcher) on someone else's turn.

Safety Week:  Defeat Plague Rat in Pike Industrial Complex without heroes destroying an environment card.

Slight of Hand:  As Argent Adept have other heroes play 5 cards during your turn.

EXTREME!!!

No Animals were Harmed:  Defeat the Matriarch when no hero target deals damage to a fowl card.  

Flower Power:  Defeat Akash'bhuta when no hero target but The Argent Adept deals damage to a villain target.

 
 
The three Expat challenges I pulled off at once, vs. Akash.  Expat ended up Lowest HP and stayed there for 5 rounds while three different brambles pinned me down.  My friends didn't seem too worried about it, with Speed Loading and Load putting cards in play and Salvage Yard and TLT feeding me cards I was well prepared.  As soon as the brambles were gone Adept let me play Unload, I had all 5 guns, RPG Launcher in hand and 6 ammo cards in play.  It was nice.
